_comment: Broadcast mode definitions. Each mode's source, length cap, shorts pool and rescan interval live here; changing channel or parameters means editing only this file. max_seconds=0 means full length. The example uses @YourChannel - replace it with your own channel handle.

news.label: News
news.note: Rescans when moving to the next video; new uploads restart the list from the top. The shorts pool takes the newest 15.

promotion.label: Promotion
promotion.note: Aimed at promoting the other videos. Each video plays at most 450 seconds (it need not finish); the shorts pool takes the newest 50.

test.label: Test
test.note: 3 videos x 180 seconds, 6 shorts. No automatic rescan.
